name: Remove preinstalled apps (you pick which)
description: Removes the preinstalled apps YOU select from a curated candidate list (Cortana, consumer Teams, Solitaire, News...) for the current user. Deliberately excluded: the new Xbox app, Game Bar and Gaming Services - Game Pass and Game Mode features need them. Revert re-registers the staged package; if Windows has cleaned it up, reinstall from the Microsoft Store.
